headline: Hopper prices climb sharply this week, led by H100 SXM at +23%, while MI300X stays flat.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index rose +23% over 7 days to $5.33, and H200 rose +17% to $6.31, the two biggest moves in the market.
H100 SXM carries the steepest hyperscaler premium at +147%, with a hyperscaler median of $10.68 versus a neocloud median of $4.32.
MI300X leads price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, with a flat +0% weekly change and a marketplace median of $0.50 on RunPod Community Cloud.
B200 edged up +1% to a $8.55 index, with the hyperscaler median at $14.12 against $8.25 at neoclouds, a +71% premium.
A100 80GB SXM and L40S held flat at +0%, but A100 is the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour.
watch: Watch whether H100 SXM and H200 extend their gains next week, since H200 cost per PFLOP-hour already sits at $6.38 versus $3.80 for B200.
